question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Brave
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3 i.e. Cowardly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The English meaning of "**Brave**" is showing courage and readiness to face danger, fear, or difficulty.(बहादुर)

 
 
• **Example:** The brave firefighter rescued the family from the burning building.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym is "**Cowardly**", which means lacking courage or showing shameful fear or timidity.(कायर)
 
 
• **Example:** The cowardly act of fleeing the scene left everyone in shock.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Cowardly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Elegant** means graceful and stylish in appearance or manner.(सुरुचिपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example**: She wore an elegant dress to the gala.
 
 
 
• **Cordial** means warm and friendly.(सौहार्दपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example**: The host gave us a cordial welcome at the party.
 
 
 
• **Courageous** is actually a synonym of "Brave", and it means not deterred by danger or pain; brave.(साहसिक)
 
 
• **Example**: The courageous soldier was honored for his valor.
